gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-syriac-wester: Wiry, oversized, a little showy: Tektur draws every curve like bent cable. Noto Sans Syriac Western sits beneath it in sturdy, compact lowercase, its terminals held well away from the stroke.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Noto Sans Tagalog keeps its lowercase mass in the middle of the line. If Tektur were shrunk down, its cable-bent strokes with no swelling or thinning would turn spindly beside this body's generous curve gaps.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Tektur runs smooth as a pen-plotter line, with generous openings on every curve and oversized lowercase. Noto Sans Tagbanwa follows in plain sans form, its lowercase filling most of the height and its curves left clearly open.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le reads approachably, its ink strokes tapering out before they touch and its capitals barely taller than the lowercase. Tektur sits above it, drawing every stroke at one thickness, so the heading looks wired while the sans body looks inked.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Noto Sans Tai Tham packs chalkboard lowercase up toward the capital line, with each c plainly open to view. Tektur above it is wilder, with oversized lowercase and joins as thick as its strokes, which gives the sans body something to push against.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Tektur draws a rope-thin outline with no thick or thin parts, and its lowercase is oversized. Noto Sans Tai Viet answers it through short ascenders and a tall x-height, which makes the sans body feel compact and approachable.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-takri: Expressive and a bit electric, Tektur glows like neon tube with one steady line thickness throughout. Noto Sans Takri steps in below, its small round letters left generously unclosed.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Tektur keeps its curves as fine as a drawn thread, with generous openings at every terminal. Noto Sans Tamil then looks magnified at the same size, its terminals stopping far from the stem, so the sans body feels bolder than the heading.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Tektur's strokes hold the steadiness of a drawn string, curving open with outsized lowercase proportions. Noto Sans Tangsa lets its round letters open wide beneath.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tc: Smooth drawn wire, oversized and showy: that is Tektur. Noto Sans TC then carries a long passage with large open counters and outward-opening curves, so the sans text keeps moving without crowding.
